Generates a Psychological Research Preregistration-Quantitative (PRP-QUANT)
pre-registration for the `forward-blocking-replication-online` experimental
study.

```{r envir-prereg-1}
library(preregr)
```

Initialise the pre-registration form:

```{r init-prereg-1}
fb_replication_online_prpQuant <- prereg_initialize("prpQuant_v1")
fb_replication_online_prpQuant
```

The form contains 45 fields that will be filled one-by-one below. For more
information, see <https://preregr.opens.science/articles/form_prpQuant_v1.html>.

## Section 1: Title and title page

``` {r section-1}
fb_replication_online_prpQuant <- prereg_specify(
  fb_replication_online_prpQuant,
  
  # Title
  T1 = "",
  
  # Contributors
  T2 = ""
)
```
